thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: elevated 503s and runtime-fallbacks for model-serving-prod in us-west-2. Triggered by surge in requests to /v1/generate. Severity: P1. Notifying on-call.

sam_oncall: ack. I’m on it — pulling logs and current routing.

lee_sre: I can help. Seeing a spike in queue latency on gpu-pool-3 and ~40% fallback to cpu-quantized instance group. Errors look like `kvcache OOM` followed by retry storms.

maria_eng: confirming — rollout of the new KV-cache heuristics landed ~20m ago and matches timing. Canary passed but we didn't catch heavy prefix reuse pattern.

ashok_platform: initiating emergency scale of dedicated-fallback group to reduce retries. Command:

```
# scale fallback pool
redwood ctl pool scale --name dedicated-fallback --replicas 12 --region us-west-2
```

sam_oncall: scaled to 12 replicas. Traffic shifting now. Monitoring qps and 5xx rate.

lee_sre: adding short-term routing policy to prefer smaller context instances to avoid KV blowouts:

```
# update runtime routing priority
redwood ctl routing update --route /v1/generate --policy prefer:small_ctx,fallthrough:large_ctx
```

maria_eng: rolled back the KV-cache heuristic flag for canary cohorts (flag: kv-heuristic-v2) to cut the regression. Command used: `feature-flag disable kv-heuristic-v2 --env prod --scope canary`

incident-bot: Status update: mitigation applied. 5xx rate dropped from 6.4% -> 0.9% over the last 5m. Latency p95 improved from 1.9s -> 1.1s.

emily_cs: @sam_oncall / @maria_eng heads-up — we have two enterprise customers on affected routes. I’ll prep customer-safe language but need confirmed impact window and mitigation summary.

sam_oncall: impact window estimate: 2025-06-12T14:04:00Z to 2025-06-12T14:27:00Z. Root cause suspected regression from KV-cache heuristics plus traffic prefix pattern.

emily_cs: draft customer note (for review):

"We experienced an elevated error rate on model-serving-prod between 14:04–14:27 UTC. The issue was caused by a recent cache heuristic change interacting with high prefix-reuse traffic, which triggered fallback behavior and retries. We mitigated by scaling fallback capacity and rolling back the heuristic. Service returned to normal within ~23 minutes. We’ll share a post-incident summary with timeline and actions."

sam_oncall: LGTM. Add: we ran a canary rollback and temporarily updated routing to prevent the pattern from resurfacing.

emily_cs: added. Sending to customers now.

lee_sre: Quick internal status-page draft:

"Incident (P1) — Elevated 5xxs for model-serving-prod in us-west-2. Start: 2025-06-12 14:04 UTC. Mitigation: scaled fallback pool, disabled kv-heuristic-v2 canary, temporary routing change. End: 2025-06-12 14:27 UTC. Impact: increased latency and transient 5xxs affecting a subset of requests. Root cause under investigation; follow-up RCA will be published."

maria_eng: action items for RCA:
- Reproduce the prefix-reuse + kv-heuristic interaction in staging (assigned: maria_eng)
- Add guardrail to runtime to limit retry storms (assigned: lee_sre)
- Improve canary signal for cache behavior under high prefix reuse (assigned: ashok_platform)
- Customer comms and timeline (assigned: emily_cs)

ashok_platform: I’ll start a postmortem branch and add test harness for long-prefix reuse workloads. ETA for PR: EOD tomorrow.

sam_oncall: handoff to next on-call in 30m. Leaving notes in pager duty and on the incident doc.

emily_cs: sent to customers and updated support cases. Copying internal status page now.

lee_sre: follow-up immediate mitigations: add short 30s cooldown on automatic retry for fallback-trigger events to avoid amplification. Planning to ship change as hotfix after postmortem triage.

maria_eng: timeline note for RCA:
- 14:02 UTC: kv-heuristic-v2 rolled to canary (~5% traffic)
- 14:04 UTC: increased prefix-reuse traffic spike -> unexpected cache eviction pattern
- 14:08 UTC: first pager triggered (5xx > 5% threshold)
- 14:10 UTC: emergency scale of fallback pool initiated
- 14:17 UTC: rollback of kv-heuristic-v2 canary
- 14:27 UTC: 5xx rate below threshold; services stable

sam_oncall: leaving final note: everyone — thanks for fast response. Please add follow-up PFAs (preventative and follow-up actions) to the postmortem doc. I’ll create the incident thread in the incidents channel with link to taskboard.

emily_cs: adding customer follow-up item: offer 1-month credit to enterprise customers affected and schedule a sync if they request technical deep-dive.

incident-bot: Incident resolved and status updated to "service restored". Postmortem link: <https://redwood-internal/pm/INC-2631234567>

sam_oncall: handing off to @lee_sre for ongoing RCA work. I’m available if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:
